Dinner, above it all

Set at Shaheen Chowk in the Intellectual Village of Bahria Town Phase 7, Kallisto was built around a simple idea: the food of the open fire, served at a table worth dressing for. The grill sits at the heart of the kitchen, and everything — from the first mezze to the last karahi — is prepared fresh, over real charcoal and in small batches.

Come for a family celebration, a quiet dinner for two on the terrace, or a long table of friends sharing platters the way they are meant to be shared. The kitchen moves between three traditions — smoky BBQ, the generous tables of the Middle East, and the deep, slow flavours of Pakistan — so every visit can taste a little different from the last.

  • Hilltop terrace and indoor diningChoose the open sky or the warmth of the dining room.
  • Groups and family gatherings welcomeCall ahead and we will set the long table.
  • Fresh from the fire, every serviceNothing pre-cooked — the grill is lit when you order.

Three traditions, one grill

The Kallisto kitchen draws on three great food cultures. The selection changes with the season and the market — call for today's menu.

Charcoal BBQ

Our grill masters work over live charcoal, turning skewers by hand until the edges char and the centres stay tender. Expect deeply marinated cuts, house-blended spice rubs, and that unmistakable kiss of smoke in every bite — served sizzling, straight from the fire to your table.

Call for today's menu →

Middle Eastern

A table built for sharing: silky whipped dips, bright chopped salads, olives and pickles, warm breads pulled fresh from the oven, and skewers grilled the Levantine way. Olive oil, lemon, sumac and fresh herbs keep every plate vivid — the perfect opening to a long Kallisto evening.

Call for today's menu →

Pakistani

The classics, cooked with patience: karahis tossed to order in the wok, slow-simmered gravies layered with hand-ground spices, and fragrant rice dishes made for the middle of the table. Finished with fresh ginger, green chillies and coriander — bold, generous, and unmistakably desi.

Call for today's menu →

Plan your visit

You will find us at the top of Bahria Spring North. Reservations are recommended, especially for the terrace and for larger groups.

Hours & reservations

Kallisto serves lunch and dinner daily, with the grill at its best in the evening. Seating — particularly on the terrace — fills quickly on weekends.
